title: Yin Yang
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Yin
learningObjectives: Trace how the yin-yang symbol is constructed from an outer circle, two half-radius semicircular arcs, and two small dot circles
Calculate arc point coordinates using x = radius * cos(angle) and y = radius * sin(angle) over ranges expressed with HALF_PI and PI
Explain how the size slider from 50 to 350 rescales the radius and how constrain() keeps the label text size readable
Design a labeled diagram of two complementary ideas by editing the yin and yang text inputs
Identify the p5.js drawing primitives circle(), arc(), beginShape(), and vertex() used to build the curved regions
